axes.concept: Molde: a decorator presses, seats and packs event pieces in a molded tool tray. Latex and foil inform the rounded cavities, table silhouette and responsive press feedback.
axes.layout: A wide overhead scene occupies the upper left, a specification tag seats at its right, and an eight-shape cavity tray follows below. Backing becomes a broad specimen tray, the shopping list a quantity-first packing slip, and export a two-part parcel. At 700px these planes stack; the four-tool belt stays near the bottom.
axes.navigation: A fixed lower four-station molded toolbelt selects Tables, Backing, List and Export. Table cards add at default dimensions and enter the inspector immediately; inline Return and Undo keep the working context. A separate help dialog explains Blender import; native planning selectors remain outside the product.
axes.typography: Embedded local FreeSerif Bold Italic at 54–88px gives the working title a sculpted, compressed silhouette; embedded Liberation Sans at 13–26px handles labels and data. Quantity-first packing numerals use the expressive serif at 38–45px. This pairing differs from sibling condensed and rounded sans directions.
axes.density: Generous scene field and 26px inspector insets, four 20px-inset cavities across desktop and two 16px-inset cavities on phone. Working controls have at least 44px targets; selection, capacity and next action remain explicit text. No KPI dashboard or ornamental metrics.
axes.components: Real installed shadcn/Base UI Button, Input and Skeleton; Animate UI Base UI Dialog primitives, Motion drag and profile springs. Custom SVG table/balloon/prop silhouettes, molded toolbelt and packaging composition. Existing pure table normalization, contours, chair placement and repository ownership are bundled read-only from Pictures.
axes.colour: Proposed raspberry #a20c48 actions on pink packing material #f4dfe7, dark plum #381526 ink, foil #c79750 restricted to decorative material. Dark plum ground #28131f and #3a2030 surfaces use pale rose #ffc0d7 actions and #fff1f7 text. Existing Pictures semantic roles map onto kit roles; purple production values are not silently changed.
axes.motion: Press-and-seat grammar with cubic-bezier(.18,1.38,.48,1), expressive 720ms plane/label choreography and 180ms controls; tray perspective seating, italic type compression, label torsion, staggered cavity/chair clips, toolbelt engagement, parcel unrolling, ambient latex breathing, error pressure release, success stamp and interruptible direct dragging. Natural 460/160ms, subtle 260/120ms; reduced/still has immediate parity. Ambient effects pause offscreen and in hidden tabs.
